sampleCoherenceSource: Single telemetry snapshot plus scene-node/simulation-clock recheck. coherent means this guard matched, not atomic publication of every engine field.
viewAnglesSource: Selected bot reflected C_CitadelPlayerPawn::m_angEyeAngles (replicated); m_angClientCamera retained separately as a diagnostic. Not raw CUserCmd angles.
buttonsSource: Physical keyboard snapshot from the operator controlling the native recorder bot; NOT verified bot-executed buttons
inputEventSource: Operator WH_KEYBOARD_LL press/release events with default physical bindings. Use while manually controlling the bot during native recording, NOT autonomous playback. These are physical keys, not an authoritative bot command stream; custom Deadlock binds are not synchronized.
engineInputSource: Read-only CPlayer_MovementServices polling, two bounded snapshots and pointer recheck. Raw m_nButtons member bytes are always retained; masks are decoded ONLY when the nested array offset is reflected. Press command numbers, last processed command and OLD view angles are optional/null when not reflected. Not a complete CUserCmd stream; polling can miss commands. Not used for conversion yet.
cameraEventSource: Dedicated ~2 ms selected bot m_angEyeAngles transition recorder; replicated client observations, not authoritative executed CUserCmd angles
